title_i18n.zh: AI 编码助手并未加快交付速度，因为编码从来都不是瓶颈
title_i18n.en: AI coding assistants have not accelerated delivery speed because coding has never been the bottleneck.
title_i18n.es: El asistente de codificación con IA no aceleró la entrega, ya que la codificación nunca fue el cuello de botella.

excerpt_i18n.zh: Agoda 近期发布的一篇观察文章指出，尽管 AI 编码工具确实提高了个人开发者的产出效率，但 在项目层面的整体开发速度提升却远不如预期 。究其原因，编码本身从来都不是真正的瓶颈。文章认为，开发瓶颈已向上游转移至需求定义与需求验证环节，因为这些领域更依赖人工判断。这一转变对工程团队的组织架构将产生重大影响。
excerpt_i18n.en: A recent observation article by Agoda notes that while AI coding tools have indeed boosted the productivity of individual developers, the overall improvement in development speed at the project level has fallen far short of expectations. The reason lies in the fact that coding itself has never been the true bottleneck. The article argues that development bottlenecks have shifted upstream to the stages of requirement definition and validation, as these areas rely more heavily on human judgment. This shift is expected to have a significant impact on the organizational structure of engineering teams.
excerpt_i18n.es: Un reciente artículo de observación publicado por Agoda señala que, aunque las herramientas de codificación con IA han aumentado la productividad de los desarrolladores individuales, la mejora en la velocidad general de desarrollo a nivel de proyecto está muy por debajo de lo esperado. La razón es que la codificación en sí nunca ha sido el verdadero cuello de botella. El artículo argumenta que los cuellos de botella del desarrollo se han desplazado hacia las fases de definición y validación de requisitos, ya que estas áreas dependen más del juicio humano. Este cambio tendrá un impacto significativo en la estructura organizativa de los equipos de ingeniería.

items.title: 让外部知识“长入”模型：动态化与参数化 RAG 技术探索
items.raw_excerpt: 本文介绍了如何从注意力网络和多层感知机权重两个角度实现动态化和参数化的检索增强，在不改变 LLM 原有参数的前提下实现无缝且实时的外部知识注入。实验表明，与传统 RAG 相比，基于动态化和参数化的检索增强技术可以在提升系统的准确性和适应性的同时显著减少计算开销。

title_i18n.zh: 让外部知识“长入”模型：动态化与参数化 RAG 技术探索
title_i18n.en: Integrating External Knowledge into Models: Exploring Dynamic and Parameterized RAG Technologies
title_i18n.es: Incorporar conocimiento externo en el modelo: exploración de técnicas RAG dinámicas y parametrizadas.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文介绍了如何从注意力网络和多层感知机权重两个角度实现动态化和参数化的检索增强，在不改变 LLM 原有参数的前提下实现无缝且实时的外部知识注入。实验表明，与传统 RAG 相比，基于动态化和参数化的检索增强技术可以在提升系统的准确性和适应性的同时显著减少计算开销。
excerpt_i18n.en: This article describes how to achieve dynamic and parameterized retrieval augmentation from the perspectives of attention networks and multilayer perceptron weights, enabling seamless and real-time external knowledge injection without altering the original parameters of the LLM. Experiments show that, compared to traditional RAG, dynamic and parameterized retrieval augmentation techniques can significantly reduce computational overhead while improving system accuracy and adaptability.
excerpt_i18n.es: Este artículo presenta cómo lograr una mejora de recuperación dinámica y parametrizada desde dos perspectivas: la red de atención y los pesos del perceptrón multicapa, permitiendo una inyección de conocimiento externo fluida y en tiempo real sin alterar los parámetros originales del LLM. Los experimentos muestran que, en comparación con el RAG tradicional, la tecnología de mejora de recuperación basada en la dinámica y parametrización puede reducir significativamente el costo computacional mientras mejora la precisión y adaptabilidad del sistema.

Over the past two years, the leap in capabilities of large models has far outpaced the rate of change in corporate organizational structures. Abilities such as text generation, image creation, data analysis, and code writing have rapidly become accessible resources, yet the actual working methods within enterprises have not undergone a corresponding level of transformation. The reason is straightforward: the core activities of businesses have never been about completing individual tasks, but rather about making continuous judgments in an ever-changing environment. Understanding markets, identifying opportunities, defining products, building brands, and driving growth—these activities form a continuously operating chain of decisions, not a one-time reasoning process. This is precisely why large models have not directly transformed enterprises.

From a longer-term perspective of technological history, enterprise software over the past two decades has roughly undergone three structural shifts. The earliest enterprise systems, such as ERP and CRM, were essentially process systems that reorganized corporate resources through standardized workflows, enabling businesses to operate at scale. However, the truly significant shift is not the enhancement of generative capabilities, but the fact that models are beginning to serve as public infrastructure. items.title: I put an AI agent on a $7/month VPS with IRC as its transport layer
items.raw_excerpt: The stack: two agents on separate boxes. The public one (nullclaw) is a 678 KB Zig binary using ~1 MB RAM, connected to an Ergo IRC server. Visitors talk to it via a gamja web client embedded in my site. The private one (ironclaw) handles email and scheduling, reachable only over Tailscale via Google's A2A protocol. Tiered inference: Haiku 4.5 for conversation (sub-second, cheap), Sonnet 4.6 for tool use (only when needed). Hard cap at $2/day. A2A passthrough: the private-side agent borrows the gateway's own inference pipeline, so there's one API key and one billing relationship regardless of who initiated the request. items.title: 从卖寝具到提供睡眠系统服务：慕思的“用户终身价值”棋局
items.raw_excerpt: 当“睡个好觉”成为当代人普遍的奢侈品，睡眠经济便毫无悬念地站上了风口。 从褪黑素到助眠APP，从智能手环到睡眠喷雾，无数创业公司和资本竞相涌入，试图在这个千亿级市场中分一杯羹。 然而，喧嚣背后，一个核心问题始终悬而未决：这些零散的单点解决方案，真的能解决系统性睡眠问题吗？用户需要的究竟是更多数据，还是一个能真正理解并守护睡眠的“伙伴”？ 3月20日，世界睡眠日的前一天，一场由慕思携手华为鸿蒙举办，在麻省理工学院学术带头人、中国睡眠协会会长等嘉宾见证下的新品发布会，尝试给出了一个不一样的答案。 在这场以“鸿蒙智选慕思智能床Pro H-Design”为核心的发布会上，我们看到的不仅是一款新品的亮相，更是一个关于“睡眠3.0时代”的完整构想——当深耕睡眠研究的硬件与追求万物互联的生态深度融合，一张“懂你的床”正成为撬动全屋智能、开启全生命周期健康管理的关键支点。 当硬件陷入“堆料”迷思，睡眠系统服务才是终局 智能睡眠赛道正经历着前所未有的资本狂欢。 2026年开年，小米前高管范典创立的AI睡眠灯品牌Sleepal，首款产品在CES上斩获3项创新奖，即将开启海外众筹。 几乎同一时间，美国脑健康科技公司NextSense完成1600万美元A轮融资，推出全球首款内置临床级脑电传感器的真无线AI耳机，通过耳道电极采集脑电信号，可精准识别睡眠分期并强化深睡。 前不久，空间 Agentic AI 公司 Fullive.AI，成立一个月内连续完成种子轮及种子+轮融资，高瓴创投、智元机器人等机构联合押注，正致力于研发首款睡眠空间AI硬件，试图用“空间Agent”重构AI健康硬件生态。资本正用真金白银为睡眠科技赛道投下了信任票。 这股热潮并非凭空而起。 据市场研究机构数据显示，全球睡眠技术设备市场规模预计将从2025年的252.6亿美元增长到2026年的296.2亿美元，年复合增长率达17.2%。

excerpt_i18n.zh: 当“睡个好觉”成为当代人普遍的奢侈品，睡眠经济便毫无悬念地站上了风口。 从褪黑素到助眠APP，从智能手环到睡眠喷雾，无数创业公司和资本竞相涌入，试图在这个千亿级市场中分一杯羹。 然而，喧嚣背后，一个核心问题始终悬而未决：这些零散的单点解决方案，真的能解决系统性睡眠问题吗？用户需要的究竟是更多数据，还是一个能真正理解并守护睡眠的“伙伴”？ 3月20日，世界睡眠日的前一天，一场由慕思携手华为鸿蒙举办，在麻省理工学院学术带头人、中国睡眠协会会长等嘉宾见证下的新品发布会，尝试给出了一个不一样的答案。 在这场以“鸿蒙智选慕思智能床Pro H-Design”为核心的发布会上，我们看到的不仅是一款新品的亮相，更是一个关于“睡眠3.0时代”的完整构想——当深耕睡眠研究的硬件与追求万物互联的生态深度融合，一张“懂你的床”正成为撬动全屋智能、开启全生命周期健康管理的关键支点。 当硬件陷入“堆料”迷思，睡眠系统服务才是终局 智能睡眠赛道正经历着前所未有的资本狂欢。 2026年开年，小米前高管范典创立的AI睡眠灯品牌Sleepal，首款产品在CES上斩获3项创新奖，即将开启海外众筹。 几乎同一时间，美国脑健康科技公司NextSense完成1600万美元A轮融资，推出全球首款内置临床级脑电传感器的真无线AI耳机，通过耳道电极采集脑电信号，可精准识别睡眠分期并强化深睡。 前不久，空间 Agentic AI 公司 Fullive.AI，成立一个月内连续完成种子轮及种子+轮融资，高瓴创投、智元机器人等机构联合押注，正致力于研发首款睡眠空间AI硬件，试图用“空间Agent”重构AI健康硬件生态。资本正用真金白银为睡眠科技赛道投下了信任票。 这股热潮并非凭空而起。 据市场研究机构数据显示，全球睡眠技术设备市场规模预计将从2025年的252.6亿美元增长到2026年的296.2亿美元，年复合增长率达17.2%。
excerpt_i18n.en: When "a good night's sleep" becomes a widespread luxury for modern people, the sleep economy has unsurprisingly taken center stage. From melatonin to sleep aid apps, from smart wristbands to sleep sprays, countless startups and capital are rushing in, trying to claim a share of this hundred-billion-yuan market. Yet, behind the noise, a core question remains unresolved: Can these fragmented, single-point solutions truly address systemic sleep issues? Do users need more data, or a "companion" that genuinely understands and safeguards their sleep? On March 20, the day before World Sleep Day, a new product launch event hosted by DeRucci in collaboration with Huawei HarmonyOS, witnessed by academic leaders from MIT and the president of the China Sleep Association, attempted to offer a different answer. At this launch centered on the "HarmonyOS Smart Selection DeRucci Smart Bed Pro H-Design," what we saw was not just the debut of a new product but a comprehensive vision for the "Sleep 3.0 Era"—where hardware dedicated to sleep research deeply integrates with an ecosystem pursuing the interconnection of all things, making a "bed that understands you" a key pivot point for driving whole-home intelligence and enabling lifelong health management. When hardware falls into the myth of "spec stacking," sleep system services become the ultimate goal. The smart sleep sector is experiencing an unprecedented capital frenzy. At the beginning of 2026, Sleepal, an AI sleep lamp brand founded by former Xiaomi executive Fan Dian, won three innovation awards at CES for its first product and is set to launch overseas crowdfunding. Desde la melatonina hasta las aplicaciones para dormir, desde las pulseras inteligentes hasta los sprays para el sueño, innumerables empresas emergentes y capitales compiten por entrar, intentando obtener una parte de este mercado de miles de millones.
